fact: Uganda uses AI-assisted chest X-ray screening (CAD4TB) with a national threshold of 50 to identify presumptive TB; a West Nile review of records from 2021-2024 found 96.3% sensitivity and 98.0% specificity at that threshold.
title: CAD4TB's precision play: Threshold 45 optimizes TB screening in Westnile's high burden setting of Uganda
publisher: Journal of Interventional Epidemiology and Public Health (conference abstract)
